name: RNAflow: An Interactive and Reproducible Platform for Downstream Bulk RNA-seq Analysis
description: A modular Shiny application packaged as an R package for downstream bulk RNA-seq analysis: differential expression (DESeq2), QC diagnostics, PCA/UMAP/3D PCA, a linked volcano-table explorer, multi-contrast comparison, functional enrichment (GSEA/ORA), co-expression networks (WGCNA), transcription-factor and pathway activity (decoupleR), per-sample gene-set signatures (GSVA/ssGSEA), optional AI-assisted interpretation, and reproducible R-script and HTML report generation.
